# AstroVakta — Astrology Website Platform + Vedic Astrology API

> AstroVakta gives non-technical astrologers a complete branded website and business in a few
> clicks: their own domain, appointment booking with WhatsApp alerts, online payments, an
> ecommerce store for gemstones and puja products, Instagram/social media management, free
> kundli & astrology tools for visitors, and complete SEO — no coding, no agency.
> For developers, AstroVakta is also the most complete Vedic astrology REST API: 216+ endpoints
> for kundli birth charts, divisional charts (D1–D60), horoscopes, kundali matching (ashtakoot
> gun milan), 12+ dosha detections, panchang, muhurat, vimshottari dasha, gemstone
> recommendations, branded 22-section PDF reports, and AI-powered interpretations
> (OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Together — bring your own key), computed with the Swiss Ephemeris
> sidereal engine (Lahiri ayanamsha).

## What AstroVakta offers

- **Astrology website & business platform (for astrologers)**: a branded website with your own domain and free SSL, appointment booking with real-time availability and automatic WhatsApp confirmations/reminders, online payments (UPI/cards/netbanking), an ecommerce store for gemstones, rudraksha and puja products, Instagram/social media management with auto-generated daily horoscope and festival posts, free visitor tools (kundli, matching, panchang, daily horoscope) and complete SEO (meta tags, sitemap, schema markup, near-perfect PageSpeed). Live in minutes — no coding required.
- **Astrology API (for developers)**: REST API returning JSON for birth charts, horoscopes, compatibility, doshas, panchang, dasha, transits, numerology, gemstones and PDF reports. Auth via `X-API-Key` header.
- **Kundli API**: complete D1 Rasi chart with all 9 planets, house placements, nakshatras, degrees, retrograde/combustion status and dignities in one request.
- **Horoscope API**: personalized daily, weekly, monthly and yearly horoscopes computed from real-time transits over the natal chart.
- **Kundali matching API**: ashtakoot guna milan with individual koota scores, dosha analysis and compatibility verdict for matrimony platforms.
- **AI astrology API**: BYO-key AI interpretations across OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq and Together AI; the API pre-computes the full chart so the LLM only interprets, never guesses.

## Example API call

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.astrovakta.com/chart/birth-chart \
  -H "X-API-Key: avk_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"dateOfBirth":"1990-05-15","timeOfBirth":"14:30","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.2090,"timezone":"Asia/Kolkata"}'
```

## Custom development packages
- **Starter ($36/mo | ₹2,999/mo)**: 5-page custom astrology web app, mobile responsive, birth chart + horoscope integration, contact form + WhatsApp chat, branded with your logo.
- **Professional ($72/mo | ₹5,999/mo)**: 10-page custom web app, iOS + Android PWA, all 180+ endpoints, payment gateway, client login & dashboard, PDF reports, SEO optimization.
- **Enterprise ($120/mo | ₹9,999/mo)**: unlimited pages, native iOS & Android apps, custom endpoints, multi-payment gateway, admin dashboard, push notifications, 12 months support.

## Facts

- 216+ REST endpoints across 40+ categories (charts, horoscope, dasha, panchang, transit, compatibility, dosha, gemstone, numerology, KP, Lal Kitab, reports, AI)
- Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph) sidereal calculations with Lahiri ayanamsha
- 9 Indian languages supported via the `lang` parameter: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi
- AES-256 encrypted API keys; no birth-data logging
- 99.9% uptime SLA on paid plans
